title: MedStruct — Biomedical Abstract Structurer & Rhetorical Role Classification Platform
description:
Problem Statement:
Navigating dense, unstructured biomedical abstracts in clinical research and systematic literature reviews creates significant cognitive friction and synthesis bottlenecks for clinicians and researchers. Existing NLP extraction models often suffer from calibration drift, sequence order hallucinations (e.g., misclassifying intermediate objectives as background or early methods as results), and overconfident mispredictions that carry unacceptable risk in medical evidence synthesis.

Developed Solution & Key Capabilities:
MedStruct is an end-to-end, high-precision NLP application and interactive research platform engineered to automatically segment, classify, and reconstruct scientific and clinical abstracts into standard rhetorical discourse sections (Background, Objective, Methods, Results, Conclusions):
• Hierarchical & Biomedical Transformer Inference: Multi-tier inference engine leveraging domain-specific contextual language models (BioBERT, SciBERT, Hierarchical Sentence Transformers) alongside an ultra-fast, zero-GPU CPU fallback baseline (TF-IDF + Logistic Regression).
• Order-Aware Markov Transition Smoothing: Forward-backward sequence decoding algorithm incorporating empirical RCT discourse transition priors (log T, log S, log P) to eliminate discourse role inversions and preserve rhetorical flow across the abstract.
• Temperature Calibration & Error Abstention: Dev-calibrated Platt/temperature scaling coupled with role-specific confidence thresholds (targeting ≥ 90% precision) that gracefully flags ambiguous sentences as ⚠️ NEEDS REVIEW instead of forcing uncertain predictions.
• Chronological Structured Reconstruction: Real-time semantic visualizer that chronologically reassembles free-form abstracts into structured, color-coded medical research sections with live confidence indicators.
• Interactive Sentence-by-Sentence Breakdown: Tabular audit trail displaying per-sentence raw model outputs, Markov-smoothed labels, progress-bar confidence ratings, and review flags.
• Empirical Benchmark & Ablation Dashboard: Built-in model evaluation suite visualizing Macro-F1 comparisons across architectures, context-window ablations (w=0 through full abstract), and low-resource data efficiency curves.
• Clinical Data Export: One-click extraction of structured findings and sentence-level annotations into formatted JSON, CSV, and clinical reporting formats.

🛠️ Technologies & Stack:
• Deep Learning & Transformers: PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, BioBERT, SciBERT, Hierarchical Context Models
• Statistical NLP & Classical ML: Scikit-Learn, HMM / Forward-Backward Markov Sequence Smoothing, TF-IDF, Logistic Regression
• Post-Processing & Precision Toolkit: Platt / Temperature Scaling, Calibrated Selective Abstention Engine, NumPy, SciPy
• Application Architecture & UI: Streamlit, Pandas, Custom Component Styling (CSS)
• Benchmark & Data Engineering: PubMed 20k RCT Dataset, Joblib Serializer, Automated Gold-Standard Evaluation Pipeline

title: VCheque Studio — Bank Cheque Printing & Management Platform (Algeria)
description:
Problem Statement:
Preparing, calibrating, and printing bank cheques across multiple financial institutions in Algeria frequently leads to paper waste, alignment discrepancies, and manual errors in French legal monetary grammar.

Developed Solution & Key Capabilities:
VCheque Studio is a lightweight, high-precision desktop application engineered for Algerian businesses, finance departments, and professionals to prepare, visually calibrate, print, and track bank cheques with millimeter accuracy:
• Intelligent Data Input: Automatic conversion of monetary amounts (DZD) into French words conforming to Algerian banking grammar rules, currency formatting with centimes, and one-click support for crossed / non-endorsable cheques.
• Millimeter Visual Calibration: Interactive drag-and-drop and coordinate-based (X, Y in mm) visual calibration editor with grid overlays and background cheque scan templates to align fields precisely to paper dimensions.
• Preconfigured Algerian Bank Templates: Built-in layout presets for major banks across Algeria (BNA, BEA, CPA, BADR, BDL, CNEP, Algérie Poste, BNP Paribas El Djazaïr, Société Générale, Al Baraka, El Salam, and others).
• High-Precision Printing Engine: True 1:1 scale CSS rendering and printer margin compensation engine tailored for standard office inkjet and laser printers.
• Local History & Records: Embedded SQLite storage and history tracking with instant search, multi-criteria filters, status management (Printed, Saved), and dashboard analytics.
• Licensing & Security: Hardware-bound machine registration and cryptographic validation using Ed25519 signatures with native Windows registry integration.

🛠️ Technologies & Stack:
• Desktop Architecture & Systems: Tauri v2, Rust, Winreg, RFD (Native File Dialogs), NSIS Installer
• Frontend & Rendering: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, 1:1 Scale Print CSS Engine
• Database & Persistence: SQLite (tauri-plugin-sql), Supabase Sync

title: MedicalVision AI — Clinical Decision Support System for Chest Radiographs (NIH ChestX-ray14)
description:
Problem Statement:
In chest radiography, multiple pathologies exhibit overlapping visual manifestations or frequent comorbidity (notably cardiac dilation and basal pleural effusion), inducing frequent cross-pathology false positives in standard AI models.

Developed Solution & Technical Innovations:
MedicalVision AI is an end-to-end Computer Vision & Deep Learning clinical decision support system trained on the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset:
• Disentangled Representation Learning: Development of an asymmetric contrastive loss (DisentangledBCEWithLogitsLoss) explicitly penalizing cross-anatomical confusion, suppressing parasitic false positive probabilities to < 5% on pure pathology cases.
• Visual Explainability (XAI - Grad-CAM): Instantaneous generation of overlaid thermo-anatomical heatmaps with automated connected-component contour segmentation and salient bounding box extraction for suspicious lesions.
• Cardio-Pleural Differential Diagnosis Module: Real-time computation of a cardio-pleural separation metric (Δcardio-eff) paired with a synchronized dual-panel comparative viewer (cardiac silhouette vs. costophrenic angles).
• Clinical Reliability & Calibration: Platt Scaling probabilistic calibration guaranteeing positive Brier Skill Scores (BSS > 0) alongside epistemic uncertainty estimation via Monte Carlo Dropout to secure borderline clinical decisions.
• Methodological Rigor: Strict zero-leakage patient-disjoint cohort evaluation with 3,000 clustered patient bootstrap iterations and supervised lesion detection via Faster R-CNN trained on NIH expert radiologist annotations.

📊 Measured Benchmark Results:
• Macro ROC-AUC: 0.7857 (+8.8 pp gain over global baseline)
• Macro Recall: 66.85% at high-sensitivity clinical screening threshold
• Spatial Correlation: Pearson r = -0.577 confirming orthogonal spatial visual attention between cardiac border and pleural recesses

🛠️ Technologies & Stack:
• Deep Learning & Vision: Python, PyTorch, Torchvision, DenseNet-121, ConvNeXt-Tiny, ResNet-50-FPN
• Explainability & Detection: Grad-CAM, SciPy, Faster R-CNN (NIH expert annotations)
• Advanced Modeling: Asymmetric Contrastive Margin Loss, Platt Scaling, Monte Carlo Dropout
• Frontend UI: Streamlit (Interactive Clinical Decision Support Dashboard)

title: HospFlow AI — Multi-Horizon Hospital Bed Occupancy & Capacity Pressure Forecasting System
description:
Problem Statement:
Hospital bed saturation during seasonal peaks causes severe strain on emergency departments and clinical workflows. Classical recursive forecasting models compound errors over extended horizons, limiting operational planning and proactive bed allocation.

Developed Solution:
HospFlow AI is an end-to-end Machine Learning decision-support system for hospital capacity management, trained on real-world daily census records from NHS England (UEC Daily SitRep):
• Direct multi-horizon strategy: Separately models occupied and available beds to capture winter escalation bed flexibility while preventing error compounding across forecast horizons.
• Capacity pressure triage: Automated 4-tier pressure classification (Normal, Moderate, High, Critical ≥ 92%), 95% uncertainty interval quantification, and dynamic surge bed requirement estimation.
• Temporal ML validation & audit: Walk-Forward Cross-Validation (5 rolling folds), formal verification against data leakage, and rigorous benchmarking against statistical baselines (SARIMA, Holt-Winters, rolling averages).
• Full-stack production deployment: High-performance FastAPI backend microservices and an interactive 7-page Streamlit dashboard featuring NHS Trust analytics, delayed discharge monitoring, and a What-If operational crisis simulator.

🛠️ Technologies & Stack:
• ML & Time Series: Python, XGBoost, LightGBM, Scikit-Learn, Statsmodels (SARIMA, Holt-Winters)
• Data Processing & Feature Engineering: Pandas, NumPy, Scipy, Openpyxl, Cyclic calendar encodings, Rolling windows & Lags (1–28 days)
• ML Validation & Serialization: Walk-Forward CV (5 folds), Joblib
• Backend & REST API: FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic
• Frontend UI & Dataviz: Streamlit (7-page interactive operational dashboard, dynamic gauge charts, uncertainty intervals, What-If crisis simulator)

title: CarePredict AI — Clinical Triage & Predictive System for Diabetic Readmissions
description:
Problem Statement:
Early hospital readmissions among diabetic patients cost billions of euros annually and represent a leading cause of preventable mortality. Most ML models in this domain suffer from data leakage or generate excessive false alerts to be viable for healthcare practitioners.

Developed Solution:
End-to-end design, training, and deployment of a rigorous Machine Learning pipeline on a cohort of over 100,000 hospital stays (Diabetes 130-US Hospitals):
• Absolute methodological rigor: Strict patient-level split (GroupShuffleSplit) eliminating 100% of data leakage across repeated stays, with realistic evaluation on an un-censored cohort.
• Longitudinal feature engineering: Modeling temporal dynamics (length-of-stay acceleration, organ comorbidity accumulation, emergency visit history) and ablation selection proving 25 engineered features outperform 73 raw features.
• Operational clinical triage: 3-tier risk system (Green, Amber, Red) achieving 47.0% precision on the Top-1% high-risk tier (a 4.2x lift over the 11.1% natural base rate).
• Production deployment: High-concurrency async REST API (FastAPI), interactive clinician decision dashboard (Streamlit), Docker containerization, and automated keep-alive ping for 24/7 uptime on Render.

🛠️ Technologies & Stack:
• ML & Algorithms: Python, LightGBM, XGBoost, Scikit-Learn, Imbalanced-Learn (SMOTE)
• Data Engineering & Math: Pandas, NumPy, GroupShuffleSplit, ColumnTransformer, StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
• Explainability & Evaluation: SHAP (TreeSHAP), Precision-Recall AUC (PR-AUC), ROC-AUC, Matplotlib, Seaborn
• Backend & REST API: FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic, HTTPX, Starlette
• Frontend UI: Streamlit (Interactive Clinical Decision Support Dashboard)
